svg.title: Groundskeeper system architecture and deployment state
svg.desc: The Vercel browser workspace currently uses demo fixtures. Its implemented live path authorizes installation-scoped queries and versioned audited writes to PostgreSQL. Separately hosted webhook ingress and leased workers analyze pinned GitHub snapshots without executing examples. Operator commands verify examples, publish approved draft repairs, and clean expired sessions. Live infrastructure remains pending.
